submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: ONE independently drawn transparent 1024x1024 game HIT animation frame, Mountain Guardian Boy 04, W frame 2.
Input 1 is current corrected hit keyframe: preserve exact character art, scale, clothing, equipment shapes, actual full-length staff and fixed camera height. This is the SAME WEST side and the edit target. Independently redraw anatomy into the specified phase without mirroring pixels or exchanging equipment hands.
Input 2: approved high-resolution character identity. Input 3: approved W IDLE establishes exact SIDE PROFILE and equipment visibility. Input 4: main approved STYLE reference, luminous rounded clean Daoist chibi hand painting. Do not draw UI.
Face points exactly SCREEN LEFT, only ONE near eye visible, never a second far eye. Keep original brown ponytail with green ribbons, youthful round face, wooden bead necklace, gold/olive-green armor, cream sleeves and pants, lion rope belt and brown gold boots.
Anatomical RIGHT hand holds the single long ring-headed gold staff; anatomical LEFT forearm carries round jade/gold shield. Left shield arm near camera and shield front visible, right staff arm far side. Do not turn the shield into a right-handed shield. Match image 3's crown view: opaque solid GOLD backing disk behind winding gold ornament. Hanging small green jade donut below remains truly hollow/transparent when unobstructed. Keep entire staff pole and both tips; not a short baton.
SPECIFIC DISTINCT POSE: The impact compresses him: unseen force from SCREEN LEFT. Torso leans backward about 11 degrees toward SCREEN RIGHT. Both knees visibly flex, pelvis lowers. Rear boot planted behind pelvis; forward boot ahead with raised heel. Near left shield elbow compresses toward ribs and shield tilts backward with forearm. Far right hand yields with the staff. One visible eye squeezes half closed in a wince.
Maintain physical shoulder/elbow/wrist connection and coherent closed gripping fingers. Two arms and two separated, clearly readable knees/ankles/boots. Preserve the approved head/body ratio and costume design, adjust pose only. No duplicate limbs or equipment. A new pose, not reused idle or a shifted rigid cutout.
One full body pose on native square canvas at least 1024x1024, preferably 1024x1024. Same camera height/character size as input 1. On 1024 canvas virtual ground/root remains (512,928); preserve actual reaction weight shift, don't independently resize to bounding box or put every pose lowest pixel on ground. Whole staff and both shoes within safe margins. 
True RGBA transparency, including unobstructed ring openings. No floor, shadow, background, grid, text, labels, particles, magic or impact FX, blur or watermark.
Retain the full long lower staff: it must reappear through a plausible clear gap after any coat/leg occlusion, with its gold bottom point visible. Match the keyframe's pole length and straight axis.
